text:
```yaml
name: Check Milestone

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]
    branches:
      - release/7.0

jobs:
  check-milestone:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'release/7.0'
    steps:
      - name: Check if PR has milestone
        run: |
          if [ -z "${{ github.event.pull_request.milestone }}" ]; then
            echo "Error: This pull request must have a milestone assigned."
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Verify the milestone title matches expected pattern
          MILESTONE_TITLE="${{ github.event.pull_request.milestone.title }}"
          if [[ ! "$MILESTONE_TITLE" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; then
            echo "Error: Milestone title '$MILESTONE_TITLE' does not match expected format (e.g., 7.0.0)."
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "Milestone validation passed: $MILESTONE_TITLE"
```
